scope: Local software implementation/build/testing. No flashing, connected-FC tests or aircraft acceptance.
architecture: Radio XIAO -> independent radio-disabled XIAO guard -> separate physical-UART4 policy inside FC firmware.
working_tree: Uncommitted implementation; hashes below identify reviewed files.

policy.allowed_wire_encoding: Unsigned MAVLink 2, canonical guard heartbeat or DRG2 Base64 TUNNEL, fixed metadata schema; no interior MAVLink start markers.
policy.ardupilot_dispatch: Base packet handler explicitly qualified to bypass vehicle avoidance/follow override; gate first, TUNNEL routing only; heartbeat consumed.
policy.inav_dispatch: Count/consume protected input; no ordinary handlers and no report forwarding.

validation.host_suite: Passed: 5 C/C++ ASan/UBSan executables and 30 Python tests, no skips.
validation.vendor_parser_suite: Passed against generated ArduCopter 4.6.3 all-dialect headers: policy and actual receive adapters under ASan/UBSan, including signature-required rejection and virtual-handler bypass.
validation.inav_build: Passed MICOAIR743V2 and MICOAIR743V2_EXTMAG Release builds, iNav 9.0.0.
validation.ardupilot_build: Passed full MicoAir743v2 ArduCopter 4.6.3 build and final GCS_Common.cpp rebuild/link after explicit base-dispatch fix.
validation.compiler: Arm GNU Toolchain 13.2.Rel1 (arm-none-eabi-gcc 13.2.1), downloaded by pinned iNav build tooling.
validation.guard_metadata: Rechecked: droneid_guard 0.1.0, esp32c5, 211856 bytes, no radio/network components, compiler stack protection all.
validation.installer: Both pinned source checkouts verified; tests cover revision/source/board/policy tampering, symlinks, overwrite refusal, read-only checks and idempotent verification.
validation.svg: Rendered with librsvg and visually reviewed as a 760x1110 portrait page.

not_performed: No sensor, guard or FC was flashed.
No installed FC configuration exported or changed.
No hardware UART saturation, native FC state-change injection, reset, latency or fault-current measurements.
No production secure-boot/signing-key provisioning or eFuse changes.
remaining_risks: Well-formed false/replayed observations remain unverified and can reach the operator within limits.
Independent guard, FC policy and vendor firmware remain trusted code; sanitizer/build results are not a proof of memory safety.
Hardware UART/DMA ISR cost and electrical faults are outside byte-parser containment.
Existing signing-required configurations may reject the unsigned prototype; no authentication downgrade is included.
Stock FC firmware updates remove this custom FC policy.
